t: Putin Lands in New Dehli; Talks with Modi Scheduled for Friday
d: Russian President Vladimir Putin has arrived in India, with talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi scheduled for September 11 to review the India-Russia strategic partnership.

t: US Diesel Prices Top $6 Per Gallon for 1st Time in History – Report
d: The average price of diesel fuel in the United States has topped $6 per gallon for the first time in history, the fuel price tracking service GasBuddy said.

t: US Navy Acknowledges Iranian Strikes Seriously Damage Fifth Fleet Base in Bahrain
d: Acting US Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao said that Iranian forces had inflicted significant damage on US facilities in Bahrain, including infrastructure essential for basing and supplying the Navy.
